messages:
tess: running the new ambulant-int8 canary (onboard batch). funcall/schema pass dropped from 99.3% -> 89.7 on long-prefix streaming + retry. filing initial notes here.

omar: reproducible locally or only on mirror?

tess: reproduced on mirror-1 and a dedicated GPU replicate. failing samples share a pattern: an invisible PARAGRAPH SEPARATOR (U+2029) emitted right after the closing brace which breaks strict parsers in a few SDKs.

vik: can you paste the raw emission?

```
{"tool":"extract","args":{"items":[{"id":12,"text":"note"}]}}
\u2029
```

niko: interesting. token dump shows ambulant-int8 emits 0xE2 0x80 0xA9 sequence (utf-8 for U+2029) at boundaries where kvcache prefix includes pasted emails. other quant variants not showing it.

tess: correlated with retries: when router retries and appends prior suffix, the concatenated token-run sometimes crosses a decoder boundary and triggers emitting that sequence. single-shot short prompts don't fail.

omar: could be decode lookup table offset in int8 kernel or a small bug in the streaming splice code that reuses a partial decoder state.

vik: quick mitigation: enable a canary-only postproc that strips paragraph separators and normalizes control chars. I tested it on replay, pass rate recovered to 97.9. but agree it's a mask.

niko: i'll diff decoder LUTs and the compiled kernel flags for ambulant-int8 vs ambulant-ptq. also check whether a fallback kernel was used on Ampere.

infra-bot: Canary job queued: cci-91818 targeting ambulant-int8 (sharded/non-sharded) and ambulant-ptq. link: https://ci.redwood/cci/91818.

omar: also, we've observed duplicate funcall deliveries when retrying before downstream ack. we should add a short idempotency key to the funcall wire event and dedupe in the router for 250ms.

tess: agree; will add dedupe to playbook. owner assignment: niko for decoder LUT diffs + compile flags (ETA EOD), tess for canary coordination + repro gist, omar for router dedupe prototype.

vik: add a schema-delta alert rule: trigger if any quant variant drops > 2.5% vs baseline on golden sweep.

infra-bot: Created tickets: RWI-2355 (block ambulant-int8 on Dedicated if canary fails), RWI-2356 (schema-delta alert), RWI-2357 (funcall idempotency). Links: https://tracker.redwood/RWI-2355, https://tracker.redwood/RWI-2356, https://tracker.redwood/RWI-2357.

tess: i'll post a repro gist with token dumps and the seed: https://gist.redwood/g/91818-ambulant-repro

omar: small unit-test idea: tokenizer roundtrip for sequences that include U+2028/U+2029/U+00A0 across quant compile profiles. run in compile CI to catch LUT/flag mismatches.

niko: good call. i'll add it and wire the check into quant nightly.

tess: for now we'll enable the canary-only sanitizer and keep ambulant-int8 off Dedicated until we confirm. will update thread when canary completes.
